title: amyris sylvatica var. plumieri
intro: Amyris sylvatica var. plumieri, commonly known as West Indian sandalwood or Plumier's amyris, is a plant species native to the Caribbean and Central America. This plant is known for its essential oil, which has been used for its medicinal and therapeutic properties, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects. The therapeutic actions of West Indian sandalwood essential oil include its ability to reduce anxiety and stress, improve sleep quality, and alleviate pain and skin irritations. The bioactive constituents of West Indian sandalwood essential oil include sesquiterpenes, such as santalol and epi-santalol, which contribute to its therapeutic and medicinal properties.
